captions.story: The most remote place on Earth hides secrets from outer space. Discover what lies four kilometers down.

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of Point Nemo?
story.summary: This episode explores Point Nemo and its role as the world's deep-sea spacecraft cemetery. Viewers learn how over two hundred and sixty spacecraft, including the Mir space station, were retired to this isolated ocean trench.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of Point Nemo?
